BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: B.ARCH   SEMESTER: VIII/ADD
BRANCH: ARCHITECTURE   SESSION : SP/2020

SUBJECT: MUP3109 CITY & METROPOLITAN PLANNING

TIME: 2 HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
6. Tables/Data hand book/Graph paper etc. to be supplied to the candidates in the examination hall.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Define urbanization? [2]
Q1 (b) Discuss various characteristic of urbanization? [3]


Q2 (a) What is urban area as per census 1971 definition? [2]
Q2 (b) Mention the different classes of town based on size of population? [3]


Q3 (a) What is urban growth? [2]
Q3 (b) Urban growth leads to urbanization which in turn leads to some changes in urban areas.
Mention at least five important changes which have positive impact on urban areas.
[3]


Q4 (a) Explain the rationale behind concentric zone model with sketch. [2]
Q4 (b) Brief the concept of Multi-nuclei model and its applicability in modern cities. [3]


Q5 (a) Discuss the generating role of primate city. [2]
Q5 (b) Discuss the concept of rank-size rule. Who introduced the concept of rank size? [3]


Q6 (a) What is metropolitan area as defined by constitution (74
th
 Amendment) Act 1992.  [2]
Q6 (b) Define outgrowth and urban agglomeration. [3]

Q1 (a) Differentiate between ‘Statutory towns’ and ‘Census towns’ with suitable examples. [2]
 (b) Briefly discuss the trends in urbanisation (2001-2011) as per census of India with
respect to different class of cities.
[3]

Q2 (a) Discuss about the decentralization as a theme in 74
th
 Constitutional Amendment Act
(CAA) with respect to metropolitan governance.
[2]
 (b) Enumerate the characteristics of the metropolis which differentiate them from other
big cities.
[3]

Q3 (a) What are the different types of metropolitan regions? Give examples. [2]
 (b) Briefly outline the economic characteristics of metropolitan growth. [3]

Q4 (a) What would be your recommendation for planning system framework for metropolitan
area?
[2]
 (b) Discuss the planning issues for a metropolitan region. [3]

Q5 (a) List the physical characteristics of metropolitan growth. [2]

Q6 (a) Define Urban Agglomeration and Megalapolis. [2]
 (b) Elaborate some special problem issues in metropolitan planning. [3]
